about: GTA 6 sold 32.5 million units before launch (Rockstar Games press release via Business Wire, Nov 20 2026, posted on Take-Two IR: 'Grand Theft Auto VI sold 32.5 million units pre-release, a new record across all platforms.'). Comparison, same company, its own unit count: GTA V 'already has sold-in nearly 29 million units, exceeding the lifetime sell-in of Grand Theft Auto IV on console in less than six weeks after launch' (Take-Two Q2 FY2014 results, Oct 29 2013, SEC 8-K Ex 99.1); GTA V launched Sept 17 2013 (Take-Two, Sept 18 2013, SEC 8-K Ex 99.1). Sold-in = shipped to stores; Rockstar does not define 'sold' for GTA VI. All read 2026-11-21. Sources in BRIEF.md.
